name: Task Success
description: Whether the task was completed successfully or not.

name: Task Completion Time
description: Time taken to complete the task in seconds.

name: Number of Deleted Files Found
description: The number of deleted files recovered from the disk image.

name: File Importance Level
description: Importance level of the deleted files (HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW).

name: Error Message Presence
description: Whether an error message was present during task execution.
